en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling European city street with a grand neoclassical theatre building dominating the right side. The building has a richly decorated pediment with sculptures, arched windows on the ground floor, Corinthian columns above, and statues along the roofline. Electric trams, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing move along a broad cobbled avenue with tram tracks. Multi‑story historicist buildings line the street, and in the far distance a tall, narrow Gothic‑style church spire rises over the city. Trees and a small garden sit in front of the theatre.
